facts.statement: Heroes is the newest expansion of the Free Realms trading card game and adds new features.
facts.quote: "Heroes" , die neueste Erweiterung des Free Realms Sammelkarten Spiels ist da!

article_summaries.title: Trefft die Wächter des Reichs
article_summaries.summary: A German-language SOE news post announcing "Heroes", the newest expansion of the Free Realms trading card game, with a story introducing four Realm Guardians (Geisterschatten, Magotron, Wildkralle, Adlersehne), each with a card set, weapon and mount, and listing new card mechanics. The page gives a relative date ("2 Monate, 6 Tage" ago) rather than an absolute one, so the exact posting date is unknown.
